Man Sentenced for Assaulting US Lawmaker Ilhan Omar

A man has been sentenced to 14 months in prison for assaulting U.S. Representative Ilhan Omar. The incident involved the man spraying Omar with vinegar. The sentencing took place in Minnesota.
